title: Zero-free regions and concentration inequalities for hypergraph colorings in the local lemma regime
summary: We show that for $q$-colorings in $k$-uniform hypergraphs with maximum degree $Δ$, if $k\ge 50$ and $q\ge 700Δ^{\frac{5}{k-10}}$, there is a "Lee-Yang" zero-free strip around the interval $[0,1]$ of the partition function, which includes the special case of uniform enumeration of hypergraph colorings. As an immediate consequence, we obtain Berry-Esseen type inequalities for hypergraph $q$-colorings under such conditions, demonstrating the asymptotic normality for the size of any color class in a uniformly random coloring.
